body:
Current Minecraft  Username:   MexicanJew

The reason you were temp-banned/banned:    



Why you should be unbanned from the server:

Honestly, i do not remember using any  hacking clients whatsoever.    You can put me through several tests if needed.
I  wasn't active in minecraft for quite a while now, but since this is the only server i was playing, i decided to  come back as i thought  my ban was only temporary, but since its not i decided to make  an appeal.

-  Was my temp  ban /  ban  false? ( In my opinion yes, since  the  moderator /  admin who banned me didn't have  solid proof as far as i can remember).
-Do I have any evidence to show the staff if was false?  (No, but as i mentioned before, you can put me through several tests  to make sure i don't  and didn't use any aimbot  clients).
-Have I waited long enough to be un-banned?  (More than a year).
- Have I been caught ban evading?   (No).
- Have I appealed a ban before?  ( I haven't, since i stopped playing minecraft since i got banned).
Sorry for any misunderstandings regarding my english.
